easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.
